title: Glowing aeroplane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='42' ry='18' fill='#1a3a5c' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Fuselage body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='30' ry='8' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='49' rx='28' ry='6' fill='#81d4fa'/>
  
  <!-- Cockpit windows -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='48' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#e1f5fe'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='47' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#b3e5fc'/>
  
  <!-- Nose cone -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='50' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#29b6f6'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='49' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  
  <!-- Tail fin -->
  <polygon points='22,50 12,30 18,30 26,50' fill='#29b6f6'/>
  <polygon points='22,50 14,32 18,32 24,50' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  
  <!-- Tail horizontal stabilizers -->
  <polygon points='22,50 10,50 16,46 24,48' fill='#039be5'/>
  <polygon points='22,50 10,50 16,54 24,52' fill='#039be5'/>
  
  <!-- Main wing (top) -->
  <polygon points='40,48 30,18 46,18 54,48' fill='#29b6f6'/>
  <polygon points='40,47 32,20 44,20 52,47' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  
  <!-- Main wing (bottom) -->
  <polygon points='40,52 30,82 46,82 54,52' fill='#29b6f6'/>
  <polygon points='40,53 32,80 44,80 52,53' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  
  <!-- Wing stripes/windows -->
  <rect x='42' y='26' width='3' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#e1f5fe'/>
  <rect x='42' y='62' width='3' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#e1f5fe'/>
  
  <!-- Fuselage windows -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='49' r='2' fill='#e1f5fe'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='49' r='2' fill='#e1f5fe'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='49' r='2' fill='#e1f5fe'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='49' r='2' fill='#e1f5fe'/>
  
  <!-- Engine pod on top wing -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='20' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#0288d1'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='19' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#26c6da'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='19' rx='2' ry='2' fill='#e1f5fe'/>
  
  <!-- Engine pod on bottom wing -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='80' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#0288d1'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='81' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#26c6da'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='81' rx='2' ry='2' fill='#e1f5fe'/>
  
  <!-- Engine glow trails -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='20' rx='5' ry='2' fill='#b3e5fc' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='80' rx='5' ry='2' fill='#b3e5fc' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Small sparkle stars around the plane -->
  <polygon points='88,35 89,38 92,38 90,40 91,43 88,41 85,43 86,40 84,38 87,38' fill='#e1f5fe' opacity='0.8'/>
  <polygon points='15,62 16,64 18,64 16.5,65.5 17.5,68 15,66.5 12.5,68 13.5,65.5 12,64 14,64' fill='#e1f5fe' opacity='0.7'/>
  <polygon points='85,62 86,64.5 88.5,65 86.5,67 87,69.5 85,68 83,69.5 83.5,67 81.5,65 84,64.5' fill='#e1f5fe' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Motion lines behind plane -->
  <line x1='5' y1='46' x2='15' y2='46' stroke='#4fc3f7' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <line x1='8' y1='52' x2='16' y2='52' stroke='#4fc3f7' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.4'/>
  <line x1='2' y1='54' x2='10' y2='54' stroke='#4fc3f7' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.3'/>
</svg>
